Definition
[Divergence operator on symmetric tensors] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0295, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0296 ↗ appa-def-lie-derivative-vector 1. Section A.2\group first-order-differential-operators-on-tensors

The divergence is the operator \[ \delta : C^\infty (T^*\mathcal M^n \otimes _S T^*\mathcal M^n)\to C^\infty (T^*\mathcal M^n) \] defined for every symmetric tensor $A$ and every vector field $X$ by \[ (\delta A)(X)=-(\divergence A)(X)=\sum _{i=1}^n (\nabla A)(e_i,e_i,X), \] where $\{ e_i\} _{i=1}^n$ is a local orthonormal frame field.
